data: In the top plot, what is the approximate value of the red line in the years 1940-1960

The top plot represents the Merging Index over time. The red line in this plot shows the trend of the Merging Index. To determine the approximate value of the red line in the years 1940-1960, we need to look at the data points for those years.

1. Locate the years 1940-1960 on the x-axis.
2. Observe the corresponding y-values for the red line in these years.

From the data points, the red line appears to be around 0.83 during the years 1940-1960. Therefore, the approximate value of the red line in the years 1940-1960 is **0.83**.
